name: qa_nav3
title: OS-NAV3, rows QA-FIL-013 and QA-GLB-014 of docs/qa/catalogue: Shift + Up / Down move the File screen's list by one page (the 16 rows it shows), clamped, never wrapping, on the IMPORT page in the card's /MOD folder (16 module files at the SD root: PC copy build-sdtest/, git-ignored, never committed). Nothing is opened or imported; the project and the settings are not touched. The cursor is read from the pictures (the `state` line has no list position).

steps.say: OS-NAV3, row QA-FIL-013 (docs/qa/catalogue/file.md). The card holds the maintainer's test set at its root; /MOD has 16 module files, exactly one page of the 16-row list. Watch the highlighted row: Shift + Down is a page down, so it goes to the last file, a second one stays there (no wrap), Shift + Up goes back to the first file. The plain Up / Down still move one row.

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
the IMPORT page, at the root of the card

steps.say: Move the cursor to the folder MOD (Up / Down; the folders are listed first) and press F1 (ENTER): the list shows the module files of /MOD, TYPE MOD, with the DIR field of the strip saying MOD. The cursor starts on the first file.

steps.note: ENTER /MOD (or whichever folder the cursor is on)
QA-FIL-013: the files of /MOD, the cursor on the first one
QA-FIL-013: Shift + Down, a page down

QA-FIL-013: the cursor is on the last file of /MOD (16 files, one page); the key row is the IMPORT page's, as in the simulator's picture of the page (the simulator's list is empty and F3 UP may differ there: read the cursor)
QA-FIL-013: still the last file: the move clamps and does not wrap to the first
QA-FIL-013: Shift + Up, a page up
QA-FIL-013: the cursor is back on the first file; nothing was opened or imported (the strip is unchanged)

steps.say: Plain Down moves one row; F3 goes back up to the root. Nothing was imported.

steps.note: UP to the root of the card

steps.say: QA-GLB-018 (OS-SHIFTENC, by hand): Shift + encoder one detent pages the same lists as Shift + Up / Down: File PROJECTS and IMPORT, Sample load, Modules, the engine picker, Tools (Pattern F7), Learn, the play-mode picker (Wave, Shift + F1), the Navigator and the Instr-hold list. It clamps at both ends and never wraps; the plain encoder is one entry. QA-FIL-092: File F7 EXPORT, Down to PATTERN nn, Shift + encoder moves 8 existing patterns (or to the last one) and back, stopping at the ends; the SONG row does nothing.
